mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_DATE, SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'IN' THEN QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS total_in, SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS total_out FROM STOCK_HISTORY WHERE PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND TRANSACTION_DATE >= SYSDATE - 30 GROUP BY TRANSACTION_DATE ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DATE ASC
SELECT NVL(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS today_in FROM STOCK_HISTORY WHERE PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = '입고' AND TRUNC(TRANSACTION_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT NVL(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS today_out FROM STOCK_HISTORY WHERE PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = '출고' AND TRUNC(TRANSACTION_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT NVL(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS monthly_out FROM STOCK_HISTORY WHERE PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = '출고' AND TRANSACTION_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')

SELECT M.PRODUCT_NAME AS medicine_name, SH.QUANTITY AS quantity, SH.TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transaction_type FROM STOCK_HISTORY SH JOIN MEDICINE M ON SH.MEDICINE_ID = M.ID WHERE SH.PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} ORDER BY SH.TRANSACTION_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT M.PRODUCT_NAME AS medicine_name, SUM(SH.QUANTITY) AS total_sold FROM STOCK_HISTORY SH JOIN MEDICINE M ON SH.MEDICINE_ID = M.ID WHERE SH.PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND SH.TRANSACTION_TYPE = '출고' AND SH.TRANSACTION_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY M.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY total_sold DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdat FROM PHARMACY_BOARD WHERE PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -LEVEL+1), 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT m.month, NVL(SUM(sh.QUANTITY), 0) AS total_sold FROM months m LEFT JOIN STOCK_HISTORY sh ON TO_CHAR(sh.TRANSACTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = m.month AND sh.PHARMACY_ID = #{pharmacyid} AND sh.TRANSACTION_TYPE = '출고' GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC
